The unattended moment

The gap is not measurement.
It is the moment of action.

01 · BEFOREA plan is issued

02 · DURINGFatigue changes the plan

Cadence owns the middle.

Measurement products are strong before and after training. Cadence targets the 45-minute interval where the plan actually needs to change. [Sources] Coaching-Agent/TECH-SPEC.md — problem framing. [/Sources]
The live coaching loop

Live physiology becomes the next best set.

♡MEASURE60 s

Heart-rate recovery closes during the first minute of rest.

↘DECIDE<10 ×2

Two consecutive poor rests trigger the cut in a pure rule engine.

◯EXPLAINREST

The voice layer reports the reason only while the athlete is resting.

The loop is deterministic: measure the first minute of recovery, decide in code, and let the voice layer explain the decision during rest. [Sources] https://github.com/saimali7/Coaching-Agent — recovery thresholds, pure rules engine and REST-gated voice behavior. [/Sources]
Trust by architecture

Safety and athlete agency sit outside the model.

The agent can explain and execute allowed tools. It cannot invent a threshold, reinterpret missing data, or silently overrule the athlete.

△
SAFETY CEILING182 bpm · 3 samples · abort
✓
ATHLETE OVERRIDEOne concession · named 6-rep cap
Trust comes from boundaries. Safety uses an absolute ceiling and three consecutive samples. Missing data is ignored. An athlete may override once, with an explicit compensation. [Sources] https://github.com/saimali7/Coaching-Agent — safety ceiling, missing-measurement handling and override behavior. [/Sources]
